 Print Image credit: Xbox ​ GTA 6’s launch is just around the corner, and it has brought an unusual Xbox promotion. Microsoft’s gaming brand has teamed up with DJ Khaled , who is adopting the fictional identity of “Dr. XBOX” to prescribe a day off for gaming. In a blog post, Xbox shared his message, encouraging players to put down their work and pick up a controller during GTA 6 launch week. ​ “This is not the week to be distracted by emails, meetings or somebody asking you to do something that isn’t gaming,” Khaled wrote. The campaign arrives ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI’s November 19 release, although his post does not explicitly name the game. Instead, it directs readers to a website offering personalised mock doctor’s notes that they can show their bosses. ​ What is DJ Khaled prescribing
 ​ Khaled introduces his diagnosis with a list of supposed symptoms, including twitchy thumbs, controller cramps and dreams about gaming. He describes the problem as a “Vitamin G deficiency” before delivering his proposed cure: “Take. The. Day. Off.” ​ His prescription is a day spent at home playing Xbox without interruptions. The message presents gaming time as the priority during what he calls a big week for players. ​ “I’m officially prescribing a day dedicated to doing what you love: staying home, picking up that controller and playing XBOX. No distractions. No interruptions. Just you, your favorite games and the freedom to experience the biggest week in gaming the way it was meant to be experienced,” Join conversation

 he wrote. ​ What does DJ Khaled’s mock doctor’s note offer
 ​ The blog post directs players to DrXBOX website to obtain a personalised note. Khaled suggests displaying it on a fridge, sharing it with a group chat or showing it to an employer. ​ The campaign also makes clear that his medical persona is fictional. Xbox includes this disclaimer: “Doctor’s note is not real. XBOX is not responsible if your employer doesn’t have a sense of humor. Please game responsibly.” ​ Rockstar Games has scheduled Grand Theft Auto VI for Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its official support page states that the game will become available at midnight local time in all regions on those platforms. ​
